title: A finding that names an entry the delivery left out stalls delivery again and carries the internal root's path into the shared copy
goal: delivery leaves out a findings record whose entry id is a left-out entry, and a record whose article, expect, observed paths or line name an internal root, with the header counts of the delivered findings file matching what it holds, so the shared copy passes the store gates and carries no internal path; kb/_self/querylog.md says findings follow their entries

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, json, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, glob
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def make_root(path, name, prefix, vis, sid, rel, fact):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(path, rel)), exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(path, "_root.md"), "w").write(f"---\nroot: {name}\nid_prefix: {prefix}\nvisibility: {vis}\ndescription: {name}\n---\n\n# {name}\n")
    open(os.path.join(path, "_sources.csv"), "w").write("id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by\n"
        f"{sid},https://example.com/{name},{name} doc,Example,MIT,copy,2026-10-19,v1,,,\n")
    open(os.path.join(path, rel), "w").write(f"---\ntopic: {rel[:-3]}\npriority: P3\napplies_to: \"x\"\nretrieved_utc: 2026-10-19\nsources: [{sid}]\nstatus: complete\n---\n\n# T\n\n## Summary\n{fact}\n\n## Facts\n- {fact} [DOC {sid}]\n\n## Reference\n\n## Examples\n")
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
os.makedirs(C)
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
make_root(os.path.join(C, "kb", "public"), "public", "S", "public", "S-aaaaaaaa", "planted/laps-rotation.md", "Windows LAPS rotates the local administrator password")
make_root(os.path.join(C, "kb", "team-a"), "team-a", "TA", "internal", "TA-aaaaaaaa", "mdm/enrolment.md", "Team A enrols kiosks through its enrolment profile")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self")); os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_query" + "log"))
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_query" + "log", ".keep"), "w").close()
open(os.path.join(C, ".gitignore"), "w").write("_cache/\n")
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main", C, cwd=T); g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C)
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T); g("remote", "add", "origin", O, cwd=C); g("push", "-q", "origin", "main", cwd=C)
Q = os.path.join(C, "_cache", "querylog"); LS = os.path.join(Q, "store", "2026-09"); os.makedirs(LS)
src = sorted(glob.glob("_tools/fixtures/querylog/store/2026-09/*.jsonl"))[0]
rows = [json.loads(x) for x in open(src).read().splitlines()]
pub = dict(rows[1]); intl = dict(rows[1], id=rows[1]["id"][:-2] + "f1", root="team-a",
                                 articles=["team-a/mdm/enrolment.md"], best="team-a/mdm/enrolment.md",
                                 citations=[{"line": "team-a/mdm/enrolment.md:12", "tag": "DOC", "verdict": "weak"}],
                                 question="How does team a enrol kiosks?")
hdr = dict(rows[0]); hdr["counts"] = dict(hdr["counts"], entries=2)
RF = os.path.join(LS, os.path.basename(src))
open(RF, "w").write("".join(json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for r in (hdr, pub, intl)))
FD = os.path.join(Q, "store", "findings", "2026-09"); os.makedirs(FD)
FR = "20260928T140000Z-c0ffee01"
fh = {"run": FR, "pipeline": 7, "retrieval": 8, "kb_commit": "b8a32f7d0194314eeee81dec18aed6d7b8ec1323", "counts": {"findings": 1, "open": 1}}
fr = {"id": "F-3bfb647abd99", "kind": "eval", "state": "open", "stage": "miss", "entry": intl["id"], "expect": "public/planted/laps-rotation.md",
      "observed": {"verdict": "weak", "paths": ["team-a/mdm/enrolment.md"]}}
open(os.path.join(FD, FR + ".jsonl"), "w").write("".join(json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for r in (fh, fr)))
code = r'''
import sys, json, os
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); import ql_deliver, ql_base
said = []
p = ql_deliver.Pusher(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], ql_base.run_cmd, None, said.append, cloud=False)
assert p.fetch()[0] == 0 and p.reset()[0] == 0, said
delivered, new, kept = p.local_files()
rc = p.bring(new, kept)
delivered2, _, _ = p.local_files()
print(json.dumps({"rc": rc, "said": said, "delivered": sorted(delivered2), "wt": str(p.wt)}))
'''
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, os.path.join(C, "_tools"), C, Q], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, cwd=C, timeout=300)
assert r.returncode == 0 and "Traceback" not in r.stderr, ("the delivery's local_files and bring do not run on the planted clone", r.stdout[-600:], r.stderr[-1200:])
res = json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
assert res["rc"] == 0, ("the delivery's store gates refuse the planted store: a finding names the left-out entry", res["said"])
brought = "".join(open(f).read() for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(res["wt"], "kb", "_query" + "log", "**", "*.jsonl"), recursive=True))
assert "team-a/" not in brought and intl["id"] not in brought, "a finding names the left-out internal-root entry in the shared store"
assert pub["id"] in brought, "the public row is not brought into the shared store"
got = [json.loads(x) for x in brought.splitlines() if x.strip()]
assert any(r == pub for r in got), "the delivered public row's recorded fields differ from the local store's"
hd = [r for r in got if "run" in r and "counts" in r]
assert hd and hd[0]["counts"]["entries"] == 1, ("the delivered run file's header does not count the entries it holds", hd)
assert intl["id"] not in brought and "team-a/" not in brought, "a row naming the internal root team-a is brought into the shared store"
assert intl["id"] in open(RF).read(), "the internal-root row does not stay in the local store"
assert intl["id"] not in res["delivered"], "the internal-root row counts as delivered, so its spool rows would be deleted"
